There is a guy in the  restaurant who efficiently takes care of your breakfast needs. Good quality fresh food. Altogether always had a very good stay. Whenever i am in Delhi i stay here. Decent and quiet rooms, fast service, delicious and reasonably priced food. Definitely worth the 3 nights stay. Can recommend anyone looking for accommodation here.

I recently stayed at this hotel for a day and had a wonderful experience. It is one of the best options near Tagore Garden.
The staff are exceptionally humble, professional, and genuinely passionate about their work.
The service was outstanding, and the rooms were clean, well-maintained, and had a welcoming atmosphere.
I highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting the Tagore Garden area.
